mechanism: Introduce one adult client with a visibly inadequate, damaged or misfitting state and bring them into a clearly defined professional service space. Show the specialist assessing the problem and using at least two visible tools or manual interventions. Preserve the client's identity and body registration through a staged transformation. Require both professional fit verification and one self-directed adjustment by the client, then return the client to a public context where changed posture, movement and observer response prove the result. The reusable mechanism is deficient baseline, professional assessment, attributable craft, identity-preserving transformation, dual fit confirmation and public return—not the source animated characters, body proportions, ragged coat, tailor, shop, red thread, pin, navy suit, street crowd, exact action, studio style, creator identity or model claim.

invariants.rule: Establish an adult client's visible baseline problem inside or immediately before a professional service space.
invariants.purpose: Defines what the service must change.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unproven problem makes the makeover ornamental.

invariants.rule: Show specialist assessment plus at least two visible tools or manual interventions.
invariants.purpose: Attributes the outcome to professional craft.
invariants.ablation_failure: A magical cut without process removes service causality.

invariants.rule: Preserve client identity and body registration through a staged transformation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Replacing the body or angle breaks continuity.

invariants.rule: Include professional fit verification and one self-directed client adjustment.
invariants.purpose: Proves both external quality and internal acceptance.

invariants.rule: Return to a public context where posture, movement and at least one observer response register the change.
invariants.purpose: Converts private craft into functional and social payoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending in the workshop withholds consequence.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source animated giant client, small tailor, facial identities, proportions and costume designs
the source ragged coat, red thread, pins, shirt, navy suit, vest, tie and exact transformation actions

instantiations.concept: An adult bike courier arrives at a repair studio with a rain-torn delivery harness; a gear technician measures load points, replaces straps and buckles in registered stages, checks the fit, lets the courier tighten one chest tab, then follows the courier back onto the street where stable posture and a nod from another rider prove the repair.
